1.note: Pelhřimov's main town line: the silo (industrial zone, west) – bus station – Táborská / Starý Pelhřimov (housing, east), 42 trips, most of them at the shift changes (5:00–7:30, 14:00–14:45), run through the afternoon by one bus in a fixed sequence: silo 14:40 → Táborská, Táborská 15:30 → silo, silo 15:45 → Starý Pelhřimov, Starý Pelhřimov 16:15 → silo, then silo 16:35 → Táborská. That sequence is one circuit every 120 (exact at 14:40, 15:30, 15:45 and 16:15; 16:35 is 5 min off its repeat), one bus; two separate Simutrans lines (Táborská, Starý Pelhřimov) would need two. The 14:00–14:45 shift extras (silo 14:00 and 14:20, Táborská 14:25, Starý Pelhřimov 14:45), the 16:15 silo → Táborská and the short Táborská – bus station trips (16:35, 16:55, 17:25) run over stops of this circuit and are off the pattern. Read at the bus station, 13:00–18:00 has 9 trips each way and the circuit passes it 5 times each way: the rest is the shift-change work of a second and third bus (14:00–14:45 at the silo) at no repeating minute (passing check: no branch, ≥ 3 each way at one minute, is hidden there).

3.note: A loop from the bus station run both ways: via the railway station, the hospital (nemocnice II) and Pod Dolní branou, back by Architekta Janáka and Pod Floriánem (trips reach Architekta Janáka 17–24 min out), or the other way round via Pod Floriánem first and Karlovo náměstí (8–9 min out). Each way is its own Simutrans line (one route each). Whole day via the station: 6:45, 7:15, 9:25, 10:25, 11:10, 14:05, 14:55, 16:15, 16:50, 18:25; via Pod Floriánem: 4:40, 6:00, 6:36, 7:50, 10:00, 12:05, 12:57, 15:15, 15:45, 16:57, 17:30 – about every 30 min in the afternoon between the two, at no fixed minute. Step 4 (method v4: a passing pattern is used where one exists): via the station every 180 at 16:15 and 16:50 (also 13:15, 13:50, 19:15 …; 7:15 exact too), via Pod Floriánem every 240 at 15:45 and 16:57 (also 12:57, 19:45 …), 5 real departures on the minute in the afternoon. 14:05, 14:55, 15:15, 17:30 and 18:25 are off the pattern. One bus each. A single line every 60 alternating the two ways (:15 / :45) would keep the half-hourly rhythm but hits only 15:45 and 16:15. The way via the station follows the 14:05 path by Křemešnická (its slot trips run via the railway station, Modřínová and Pod Hájkem, which the other way serves), the other way the 15:15 path by Skrýšov, so every stop of the loop is on a line. The passing check reads the loop at Čajkovského, which both ways pass, so it counts every trip as one way.

250.note: VDV regional line Pelhřimov – Humpolec – Havlíčkův Brod, Dopravní terminál: hourly through the day, leaving Pelhřimov at :43 (13:53 and 17:48 are 10 and 5 min off) and Havlíčkův Brod at :12 (13:02 is 10 min off; 18:15 and 19:15 wait for trains), 64 min, 3 buses. Short trips Pelhřimov – Humpolec, Poliklinika: out at 13:18, 15:13, 17:18 and 18:43 (and 14:10 from the silo), back at 14:07 and 18:07. Read at the Poliklinika, 5 go out and 2 come back in the afternoon: the buses sleep at the Humpolec garage (provozovna Oblast Humpolecko), so the short line runs at its inbound rate, every 240 (13:18 / 17:18 out, 14:07 / 18:07 back), and the other out trips are off the pattern (buses going home; to be confirmed by the plates on Tue 24 Nov). Kojčice, Dehtáře (with Vadčice) and Velký Rybník, obec are village stops off the main road that only a few trips serve (15:13 out; 15:12 and 13:02 in from Havlíčkův Brod); every place is served, so the short line runs through them, 6 min longer than its slot trips take.

unmodelled.2: Shift and school line silo – bus station – hospital – Táborská (20 trips, 4 in the afternoon: 13:00, 13:30, 14:15, 14:45, and 22:15). Every stop it serves is on lines 1 and 3, so it gets no line of its own (method Step 8: a long-interval line only where it is a place's only service).
unmodelled.4: Shift line bus station – silo – Osvobození / Starý Pelhřimov (12 trips: 5:03–6:51, 14:31–15:10, 22:45). Every stop is on lines 1 and 3; not modelled (Step 8).

pak.why: VDV regional buses (white with the green VDV chevrons) take VZ-VDV-bus, which has the Crossway LE LINE 10,8M and 14,5M; the ICOM town buses take the town package VZ-MHDPelhrimov-bus. The Crossway LE LINE 12M in VDV paint and the Isuzu Novociti Life in ICOM blue with a white fade were asked from the art session (simutrans-122-0-c1) on 23 Nov 2026; until they are built they show "≈" and are listed in pak_request.md.

texts.buses: The VDV live map (mapavdv.kr-vysocina.cz, Kraj Vysočina) polled every minute on Tuesday 24 Nov 2026 gives every bus's licence and trip number (the JDF trip) and its VDV vehicle number; the ČSAD buses also show their number plate, which joins them to the seznam-autobusu.cz register (read on 23 Nov 2026 in the owner's browser). The register lists no fleet numbers for ICOM or ČSAD, so a bus is named by its VDV vehicle number with its plate; a town bus the map shows without a plate keeps its VDV number and its type stays unknown. A bus fills one Simutrans line it ran in that line's window, by matching.
texts.depots: ICOM transport, provozovna Pelhřimov (the town buses; its four Isuzu Novociti Life run MHD Pelhřimov) and ČSAD AUTOBUSY České Budějovice, provozovna Oblast Humpolecko (line 250; the register files its buses at Pelhřimov and Humpolec).
texts.status_html: Version 1, 23 Nov 2026: the buses come in version 2. The VDV live map keeps no history, so it is polled all day on Tuesday 24 Nov; version 2 names the real bus on every Simutrans line. The lines, typed values and bus counts here stand unless that day shows buses pairing lines in a way the timetable hides.
